title: Wealth Management Agents
description: Intelligent agent-orchestrated and memory-augmented personalized financial advisory platform built with GeminiAIClient (agentic workflow), Fastino (user portfolio), and Linkup (web scraping). Won Self-Evolving Agents Hackathon.

title: WiFi Diagnostics Tool
description: Diagnostic tool showing key Wi-Fi metrics with real-time connection strength monitoring.

title: Intracranial Aneurysm Detection using CNNs and Supervised Learning
description: 5-fold EfficientNetV2 ensemble to detect and precisely locate intracranial aneurysms across various types of medical images, including CTA, MRA, and T1 post-contrast and T2-weighted MRI.

title: Vision Transformer Implementation with TensorFlow
description: Implemented Vision Transformer network architecture based on "An image is worth 16x16 words" 2020 paper with multi-head self-attention (MSA) and Feed-forward network (MLP).

title: ResNet Implementation with PyTorch
description: Implemented ResNet18 model based on "Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition" 2015 paper. Featuring FCNN/CNN architectures with respective training/testing loops and hyperparameter optimization on CIFAR-10.

title: Sleep Analysis using Neural Networks and Batch Norm
description: Classified non arousal and arousal time frames. Inspired from PhysioNet/Computing in Cardiology (CinC) Challenge 2018.

title: Take Down Tobacco App
description: App designed to help solve the crisis of widespread ignorance of harm caused by tobacco among teens and the lack of incentivization to avoid consuming tobacco.

title: P3 APCS Attendance App
description: Customizable iOS app for making attendance more easier especially when students may not be sitting in their assigned seat.

title: MobilityHub
description: iOS medical service finder app that utilizes NLP to recommend medical centers from user-specified symptoms or conditions based on relevance and proximity. Won HackSwift hackathon.

title: SKIB
description: Generative AI-based approach to getting better at public speaking with LLM feedback, audio transcription, and Fast Fourier. Developed in a hackathon.

title: FRC Scouting website
description: Collaborative project management tool with real-time updates and team collaboration features.

title: VisionARy
description: Tool for helping people test their eyesight, choosing glasses they like, and trying them out in AR. Developed in a hackathon.

title: Food4All
description: Tool for communication between food donors and volunteers who are willing to deliver the food to people in need. Developed in a hackathon.

title: Sentiment Analysis With Scikit-Learn
description: A sample machine learning project to showcase sentiment analysis with Scikit-Learn and other python library and packages.

title: FRCScout App
description: Allows teams to efficiently collect and store scoring, speed, and measurement data of other teams during competitions without wifi.

title: Instagram Unfollower Report
description: Give users a list of people who don't follow them back and people they don't follow back on Instagram.

title: Molar Mass Calculator
description: Calculates the molar mass of a given compound. Works for an element, binary compound, and multiple compounds.

title: OCR Based File Search Utility
description: Looks through the files of a directory for user-specified string queries. Then creates a new folder with result files.

title: Applied ML Object Detection
description: Object detection program for self-driving cars developed with YOLOv5 and OpenCV
